notes.title: V1.04 Update
notes.notes: [p]This is an emergency hotfix patch.[/p][p][/p][h2]Update details:[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed abnormal stats issue with the "Thief" tower[/p][/*][*][p]The "Bond" list can now be dragged to the top-left of the screen to remain visible[/p][/*][*][p]Enabled fast-forward function when playing "Multiplayer Mode" solo[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted table display in the "Help" section[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized some lag issues[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Our current main goal is to improve the game experience and fix various issues. New content is also in the works![/p][p][/p][h3]Note: Players using different versions cannot team up or see each other's room list.[/h3]

notes.title: V1.03 Update
notes.notes: [p]This is an emergency hotfix patch[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Update Contents:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the tower’s attack range display was not updated after using the “Attack Range” attribute card[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the gold cost for drawing function cards[/p][/*][*][p]Added a bloom effect toggle in the Settings menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a lag issue caused by the Rail Tower when using certain function cards in-game[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Note: Players on different versions cannot team up or see each other's room list[/b][/h3]

notes.title: V1.02 Update
notes.notes: [p][b]This is a small patch update[/b][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Update Contents:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]You can now use the "In-Game Configuration" directly after finishing the single-player campaign.[/p][/*][*][p]New resolution options have been added.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the UI visuals of element cards and attribute cards when they are unavailable, making it easier for players to distinguish.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Note: Players using different versions cannot team up or see each other's room list.[/b][/h3]
